body: AI Agent Framework, the Pydantic way
plain_description: The big picture: Ship production-grade AI agents faster with type-safe reliability, without complex infrastructure. Pydantic AI is purpose-built by the team behind Pydantic validation — the validation layer already trusted by OpenAI, Anthropic, and LangChain. Here's why it matters: structured outputs that never fail validation, tools that wire themselves up from your code, and observability out of the box. The bottom line: get from prototype to production without rewriting everything.
technical_description: Pydantic AI is a Python agent framework for building production-grade Generative AI applications with static type safety. The framework provides agent construction with dependency injection, structured output validation via Pydantic models, and automatic tool-calling from Python function signatures with runtime argument validation. It supports multiple LLM providers through a unified interface including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, Cohere, Grok, and others. Built-in capabilities include web search, reasoning/thinking, MCP integration, human-in-the-loop tool approval, durable execution for fault-tolerant long-running workflows and transient-failure recovery, streaming structured outputs, and graph-based control flow via type-hinted state machines. Agents can be defined declaratively in YAML/JSON configuration files. The framework integrates natively with Pydantic Logfire for OpenTelemetry-based observability, tracing, evals, and cost tracking.
title: Pydantic AI
